cases.pty-zero: Exact exclusive PTY range and genuine zero status
cases.pty-seven: Exact exclusive PTY range and genuine nonzero status
cases.pty-empty: No authored output; exact retained terminal controls
cases.split-real: Complete exact logical stdout/stderr and PTY control attribution
cases.suppress: Suppression retains complete raw split evidence
cases.replace: Replacement retains complete raw split evidence
cases.finalize: Exact finalized raw bytes and interrupted-read controls; status-free and never natural completion
cases.cancel: User cancellation cannot authorize completed assertion evidence
cases.finalize-after-return: Accepted input closure retains actual completed status
cases.cleanup-failure: Missing cleanup proof exposes no terminal operation result

counterproofs.wrong-start: Changed original completion offset must fail
counterproofs.synthetic-status: Synthetic completed status for finalization must fail
counterproofs.finalized-bytes: Corrupted finalized bytes with unchanged length and marks must fail

limits: Genuine qualification is limited to the three Linux amd64 entries
